notes: Hand-seeded from the US top_free + top_grossing charts of 2026-10-02. Mechanics describe the core loop a player repeats, not the theme or art style. An app may carry at most two. Apps that fit nothing here are assigned 'other' and reviewed manually rather than forced into the nearest entry. JSON rather than YAML so the pipeline stays stdlib-only.

mechanics.label: Sort into containers
mechanics.definition: Move items between slots, tubes or shelves until each container holds one kind. Fixed board, no time pressure, failure by deadlock.

mechanics.label: Block-fit placement
mechanics.definition: Drop irregular shapes onto a grid to clear full lines or regions. Endless, score-based, fails when no piece fits.

mechanics.label: Jam extraction / unblock
mechanics.definition: Slide or route blocking pieces out of a crowded board to free a target. Deterministic, solvable, puzzle-per-level.

mechanics.label: Traffic routing
mechanics.definition: Direct queues of passengers or vehicles to correct destinations under mounting congestion.

mechanics.label: Triple match (3D objects)
mechanics.definition: Tap three identical objects from a cluttered pile into a limited tray. Fails when the tray fills.

mechanics.label: Match-3 swap
mechanics.definition: Swap adjacent tiles on a grid to form lines of three or more, with cascades and power-ups, across authored levels.

mechanics.label: Merge with meta-progression
mechanics.definition: Combine pairs into higher tiers on a persistent board that gates a story or renovation over days and weeks.

mechanics.label: Mahjong tile match
mechanics.definition: Clear a layered tile layout by pairing free tiles. Fixed deal, solvable or not from the start.

mechanics.label: Solitaire card play
mechanics.definition: Single-player card clearing from a shuffled deal (klondike, tripeaks, pyramid).

mechanics.label: Bingo / number draw
mechanics.definition: Mark called numbers on cards against a timer, with speed and multi-card handling as the skill expression.

mechanics.label: Casino slots
mechanics.definition: Spin-based chance outcomes with no skill expression. Included for completeness and flagged as chance-framed.

mechanics.label: Screw / unfasten
mechanics.definition: Remove pins or screws in the right order so a structure disassembles without jamming. Deterministic and solvable.

mechanics.label: Physics demolition
mechanics.definition: Fire or place a limited force and let physics resolve the outcome. Aim and timing are the skill.

mechanics.label: Hole / absorb-and-grow
mechanics.definition: Steer a growing hole or mass that consumes objects within a round timer.
seed_apps: All in Hole: Black Hole Games

mechanics.label: Territory capture (.io)
mechanics.definition: Claim area on a shared board while avoiding elimination. Short rounds, direct opposition.

mechanics.label: Crowd / unit funnel
mechanics.definition: Route a growing mass of units through gates that multiply or cull them toward a target.

mechanics.label: Endless runner
mechanics.definition: Auto-forward movement with lane dodging and collection. Score is distance or pickups.

mechanics.label: Rhythm tap
mechanics.definition: Tap in time with a track. Precision and consistency are the only variables.

mechanics.label: Audio guessing / trivia
mechanics.definition: Identify a song or answer from a short audio or text clue, scored on speed and accuracy.

mechanics.label: Word formation
mechanics.definition: Build or find words from a letter set or grid against a target list.

mechanics.label: Logic deduction grid
mechanics.definition: Fill a grid by constraint satisfaction with a single correct solution. Purely deterministic.

mechanics.label: Brain teaser / lateral puzzle
mechanics.definition: Short one-off puzzles with trick solutions, loosely connected, novelty-driven.

mechanics.label: Hidden object search
mechanics.definition: Find named items in a dense scene against a timer. Visual scanning speed is the skill.

mechanics.label: Spatial rotation / alignment
mechanics.definition: Rotate or slide pieces until a pattern aligns. Deterministic, single solution.

mechanics.label: Coloring / art completion
mechanics.definition: Fill regions by number or palette. Relaxation-led, no fail state.

mechanics.label: Cue sports
mechanics.definition: Aim-and-power physics shots in turn-based opposition. Established 1v1 skill format.

mechanics.label: Abstract strategy board
mechanics.definition: Perfect-information turn-based board games with deep skill ceilings and established rating systems.

mechanics.label: Licensed sports simulation
mechanics.definition: Team or player sports sims built on real-world licences.

mechanics.label: Dice-roll board raid
mechanics.definition: Spin or roll to advance a board track, collecting and raiding other players' builds. Chance-driven with a social layer.

mechanics.label: Farm / city builder sim
mechanics.definition: Timer-gated production chains and layout management over weeks.

mechanics.label: Survival 4X / base war
mechanics.definition: Base building, troop training and alliance warfare on a persistent shared map. Horizon measured in months.

mechanics.label: Real-time arena brawler
mechanics.definition: Short synchronous multiplayer matches with collectible units and ladders.

mechanics.label: Shooter / battle royale
mechanics.definition: Real-time competitive shooting in large synchronous matches.

mechanics.label: Gacha RPG
mechanics.definition: Character collection via randomised pulls, with teams progressed through authored content.

mechanics.label: Digital trading card game
mechanics.definition: Deck construction plus turn-based duelling, with collection as the monetisation layer.

mechanics.label: Sandbox / user-generated worlds
mechanics.definition: Open creation and social play inside player-made content.

mechanics.label: Social deduction
mechanics.definition: Hidden-role play among a group, resolved by discussion and voting.

mechanics.label: Skill-cash arcade portfolio
mechanics.definition: Multi-game wrappers whose product is the cash tournament layer rather than any one game. Direct competitors to Blitz.

mechanics.label: Location-based AR collecting
mechanics.definition: Progress requires physical movement through real-world space, with collection and encounters tied to GPS position.

mechanics.label: Idle / incremental
mechanics.definition: Progress accrues while the app is closed; the loop is periodic upgrade decisions rather than moment-to-moment play.

mechanics.label: Tap-to-blast clear
mechanics.definition: Tap a group of adjacent same-coloured blocks to clear them; no swapping. Larger groups yield boosters.

mechanics.label: Poker / betting card play
mechanics.definition: Hand-ranking card play with betting rounds against other players. Skill expressed through incomplete-information decisions.

mechanics.label: Precision aim / sniper
mechanics.definition: Static or semi-static aiming at targets with ballistics, scored on accuracy and timing rather than movement.

mechanics.label: Jigsaw / picture assembly
mechanics.definition: Place fragments into their correct position to rebuild an image, often hybridised with another clearing loop.

mechanics.label: Dress-up / styling
mechanics.definition: Assemble outfits and looks against prompts, often with voting or scoring by other players.
